description: If the given externally countable transitive ZFC-model satisfies \(\kappa^{\aleph_0}=\kappa\) for an infinite cardinal \(\kappa\), every generic extension by \(\operatorname{Fn}(\omega\times\kappa,2,{<}\omega)\) has the same cardinals and cofinalities and satisfies \(2^{\aleph_0}=\kappa\). In particular CH in the ground model gives extension continuum \(\aleph_2\) when \(\kappa=\aleph_2^M\).
